sop_modules.name: Trim Finish Painting Setup
sop_modules.description: Floor protection and wall/fixture masking for trim finish painting. Protection scope varies by application method and adjacent wall state.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Perimeter Drops)
tasks.description: Set up drop cloth runners along trim work area perimeter for drip catching. Required for both brush and spray methods.

quality_notes.all: Runner-style drops along baseboard and trim run areas

tasks.name: Wall Masking at Trim Edge
tasks.description: Apply tape line and masking paper at trim-to-wall edge to protect wall surface. Required for spray method. Also required for brush method when walls are at SS_PAINTED_* state (RC-007).
tasks.state_condition_note: Spray method: always mask wall at trim edge. Brush method: mask only when walls are SS_PAINTED_* (finished). When walls are SS_PRIMED_FIELD (typical NC), brush method needs no wall masking. Driven by state_declarations.adjacent_state_protection_rules for wall_field.

quality_notes.all: Complete tape line along trim-to-wall edge. Paper drape for spray, tape-only for brush with finished walls.

tasks.name: Cover Fixtures Near Spray Zone
tasks.description: Tape over outlets and switches near spray work area to protect from overspray.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of outlet/switch plates near spray zone

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Floor protection first, then wall masking (if applicable), then fixture covers (if spray).

sop_modules.name: Trim Finish Initial Preparation
sop_modules.description: LIGHT post-primer-cure touch-up. Inspect primer surface, light sand for adhesion, touch-up cracked joints and revealed defects. NOT the heavy fill/caulk/sand from prime spec.

tasks.name: Inspect Primer Surface
tasks.description: Visual inspection of primed trim surfaces. Check for cracked caulk at joints, missed fills revealed after primer cure, primer adhesion issues, and surface defects.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick scan — note obvious cracked joints and missed fills
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection at 3 feet — mark all visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough inspection under raking light — mark all imperfections

tasks.name: Light Sand Primer Surface
tasks.description: Light sand primed trim surfaces with 150-220 grit for mechanical adhesion before first finish coat. Not a heavy sanding — just adhesion prep.

quality_notes.all: Uniform light scratch pattern for adhesion. Not removing material — creating tooth.

tasks.name: Touch-Up Caulk Cracked Joints
tasks.description: Re-caulk joints that cracked after primer cure. Touch-up scope only — approximately 10-15% of joints may need rework. Full caulk job was completed during prime spec.

quality_notes.QT4: Clean bead on all cracked joints
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect smooth bead, tooled finish on all cracked joints

tasks.notes: Touch-up only. Heavy caulk was completed by SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME.

tasks.name: Touch-Up Fill Revealed Defects
tasks.description: Spot fill defects revealed after primer cure (dents, dings, wood grain telegraph). Touch-up scope only — heavy fill was completed during prime spec.

quality_notes.QT4: Fill all visible defects at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every defect that could telegraph through finish

tasks.notes: Touch-up only. Heavy fill was completed by SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME.

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust (Initial Prep)
tasks.description: Remove all sanding and prep dust from trim surfaces with tack cloth before first finish coat.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed — surface must be clean to touch before finish application

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Light Sand Primer → Touch-Up Caulk → Touch-Up Fill → Clean Dust. All prep complete before first finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Trim Finish Coat 1
sop_modules.description: First finish coat application. Brush or spray method. Apply, tip once, walk away — do NOT overwork waterborne products (FFD 15.3.1).

tasks.name: Brush Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat with angled sash brush. Work systematically by trim type. Apply, tip once, walk away — short working time products demand proper first-pass technique (FFD 15.3.1).

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks. Application quality is NOT tiered. If marks remain, sand out between coats (FFD 15.3.1).

tasks.name: Spray Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat via airless sprayer (310-411 tip). Systematic pass by trim type. Consistent distance and speed for uniform mil thickness.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks. No orange peel. Application quality is NOT tiered.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Coat 1 is slower than coat 2 (surface absorption, establishing coverage). Followed by MOD_TRIM_INTERSTAGE before coat 2.

sop_modules.name: Trim Interstage Process
sop_modules.description: Between-coat maintenance cycle. Inspect, sand, repair, clean. Runs at ALL quality tiers — scrutiny and sanding discipline vary by tier. Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat (FFD 5.3).
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat

tasks.name: Inspect Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection of applied coat. Look for dust nibs, brush marks, missed areas, runs, and surface texture issues across all trim types.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance at 6 feet — obvious defects only
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet — mark all visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance

tasks.name: Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Between-coat sanding. Discipline varies by quality tier. Rigid sanding block mandatory for defect removal (FFD 15.4.1). Flexible sponges are NOT acceptable.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot sand only — visible nibs and rough spots. 220 grit.
quality_notes.QT4: Light full sand — entire surface, 220 grit. Uniform scratch pattern.
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough full sand — entire surface, 220-320 grit. Uniform scratch pattern. Every imperfection addressed.

tasks.name: Patch/Repair Defects
tasks.description: Fill defects found during inspection. Address issues from previous coat — brush marks, dust nibs, dings.

quality_notes.QT3: Repair only glaring defects — deep scratches, obvious holes
quality_notes.QT4: Repair all marked defects — visible at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Repair all defects regardless of size — anything that could telegraph through finish

tasks.name: Spot Coat Patched Areas
tasks.description: Apply spot coat over patched/repaired areas to build film thickness before next full coat.

quality_notes.QT5: Spot coat all repairs — ensure uniform film build

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust (Interstage)
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth before next coat application. Critical for dust-free finish.

quality_notes.all: Complete dust removal — surface must be clean to touch before next coat

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand Between → Patch Defects (if needed) → Spot Coat (if patched) → Clean Dust. Runs after each coat except the final coat.

sop_modules.name: Trim Finish Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Second finish coat application. Faster than coat 1 (consistent substrate). Same application philosophy: apply, tip once, walk away. At QT5 brush/roll, this module may run a third time (3+ coats per FFD 15.10.3).

tasks.name: Brush Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second finish coat with angled sash brush. Faster pace than coat 1 — consistent substrate. Same application philosophy: apply, tip once, walk away.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks. Application quality is NOT tiered.

tasks.notes: Also used for coat 3 at QT5 brush/roll when additional_rounds modifier applies.

tasks.name: Spray Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second finish coat via airless sprayer. Faster pace than coat 1 — consistent substrate.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks. No orange peel. Application quality is NOT tiered.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Coat 2 follows interstage. At QT5 brush/roll, this module + interstage may repeat for coat 3 (per round configuration ROUND_TRIM_FINISH_3COAT).

sop_modules.name: Trim Final Inspection and Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Final quality check and touch-up after last finish coat. Scrutiny varies by quality tier.

tasks.name: Final Trim Inspection
tasks.description: Final quality check of all painted trim surfaces. Verify coverage uniformity, sheen consistency, and defect-free finish across all trim types in each room.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance at 6 feet — no obvious defects
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet — no visible defects, uniform sheen
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection at arm's length under raking light — zero tolerance, uniform sheen across all surfaces

tasks.name: Touch-Up Defects
tasks.description: Address any remaining defects found during final inspection. Touch up with same finish product. Spot sand and recoat as needed.

quality_notes.QT4: Address all visible defects — blend touch-up into surrounding finish
quality_notes.QT5: Address every imperfection — full coat over spot repairs if needed to equalize sheen

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Touch-Up. Runs after the final finish coat (no interstage after this).

tasks.name: Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove all protection materials — floor drops, wall masking, fixture covers. Remove tape while finish is still slightly tacky for clean edge.

quality_notes.all: Remove tape at proper time — too early risks smudging, too late risks paint peeling with tape

tasks.notes: Protection continuity/teardown across specs handled at project level.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, spray equipment. Proper storage or disposal of consumables.

round_configurations.name: Standard 2-Coat Trim Finish
round_configurations.description: Standard coat sequence for QT3/QT4 (all methods) and QT5 spray.
round_configurations.notes: 2 finish coats with 1 interstage between. QT5 spray also uses this configuration.

round_configurations.name: Extended 3-Coat Trim Finish (QT5 Brush/Roll)
round_configurations.description: Extended coat sequence for QT5 brush/roll per FFD 15.10.3. 3+ coats typical for brush application at gloss sheen.
round_configurations.notes: 3 finish coats with 2 interstages. Coat 3 uses same rates as coat 2 (consistent substrate). Per human resolution: do NOT enforce spray for QT5 gloss.

assumptions.value: Initial prep is LIGHT touch-up only — heavy prep was done by companion SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME spec
assumptions.note: This finish spec's prep module is intentionally lighter than the prime spec's prep. Touch-up caulk ~10-15% of joints, spot fill only.

assumptions.value: Coat 3 at QT5 brush/roll uses same task IDs and rates as coat 2 (TSK_TRIM_BRUSH_FINISH_2)
assumptions.note: No separate coat 3 rates defined. Coat 2 rates apply — substrate is consistent after first coat.

assumptions.value: Brush method requires wall masking (tape only, no paper) when walls are SS_PAINTED_*
assumptions.note: RC-007 correction: spec must support trim finish after walls are painted. Brush method needs tape line to protect finished wall paint from brush contact/drips.
